rationale: VERSION 2.0.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced independently sampled checkerboard/rectangle marginals with all four complete linked published scene structures.; Added all eight global D4 input transforms and injective canonical/remapped palette modes with nonzero rectangle colors.; Replaced five numeric/dead/degenerate controls with exact scene_profile, orientation, and palette_mode axes recovered by observe_overrides.; Added strict call validation, full returned-grid color-isomorphism, component-level self_check, independent Python rule mirror, deterministic fresh returns, and RULE_HASH.; Added six focused test groups, main/disjoint 60,000-draw censuses, fit checks, negative noise/solid recombinations, and 513-case live-Racket parity/purity.; Calibrated final profile weights to keep every public profile within a roughly 1:3 per-band ratio while maintaining the documented finite-space output diversity above 70%.; Enumerated object-color permutations from seed/sample_index to reduce avoidable output collisions without changing semantics.
summary: For each color, find its 4-connected components and retain every component with at least two cells and a bounding box at least 2x2. Sort those records by bounding-box area descending. Rebuild the largest record as the output canvas, treating a record as solid only when its cell count fills its bbox and otherwise as a frame. Place each later record bottom-left inside the preceding record, preserving frame interiors already painted.
